name: Paladin
description: A warrior bound by an oath they swore themselves. That oath is the source of the power: smites that burn the wicked, auras that steady allies, and a conviction that does not bend.
full: A paladin's power comes from an oath they swore themselves, not from a god. That distinction matters: the conviction is the source, and breaking it costs them everything. What it buys is a warrior who heals, protects, and detonates.

Divine Smite converts spell slots directly into damage, making paladins the best burst damage in the game against the things that most need burst damage. Lay on Hands is a pool of healing that never runs to waste, and their auras quietly make everyone standing near them harder to kill.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: As an action, know the location of any celestial, fiend or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover, and of any consecrated or desecrated ground. Usable 1 + your Charisma modifier times per long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: A pool of healing equal to five times your paladin level, spent by touch. Five points from the pool cure one disease or neutralise one poison. The pool refills on a long rest.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a style of combat such as Defense, Duelling, Great Weapon Fighting or Protection.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You draw on divine magic through prayer and meditation, preparing a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage, plus 1d8 per slot level above first, to a maximum of 5d8, and one die more against undead and fiends.

features.name: Divine Health
features.description: The divine magic in you makes you immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description: Swear the oath that binds you. It grants Channel Divinity options and oath spells at 3rd level, and further features at 7th, 15th and 20th.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier, minimum 1, to every saving throw. The radius grows to 30 feet at 18th level.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and friendly creatures within your aura cannot be frightened while you are conscious.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.description: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage, with no slot spent.

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.description: As an action, end one spell on yourself or on a willing creature you touch. Usable your Charisma modifier times, minimum once, per long rest.
